no_adcom_quote.quote: As previously stated, the application was not presented before the Antimicrobial Drugs Advisory Committee because a preliminary review of the NDA, including labeling, did not reveal any significant clinical or safety issues that would benefit from an advisory committee discussion.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for Genvoya (NDA207561). The FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office Director memo, and Medical Review) all state that the application was not presented before the Antimicrobial Drugs Advisory Committee because a preliminary review revealed no significant clinical or safety issues warranting AC discussion, and because three of the four component drugs were already approved while TAF is a second prodrug of a well-characterized NRTI. With no meeting held, there are no committee concerns or resulting changes to link to the approval.
